# I-31 additive pulses. Do not edit I-28 or other feature on_action files.

on_yearly_pulse_country = {
	on_actions = {
		sp_i31_yearly_pulse
	}
}

on_monthly_pulse_country = {
	on_actions = {
		sp_i31_monthly_pulse
	}
}

sp_i31_yearly_pulse = {
	effect = {
		sp_i31_try_add_identity_jes = yes
		sp_i31_yearly_soft_relations_drift = yes
	}
}

sp_i31_monthly_pulse = {
	effect = {
		sp_i31_try_add_identity_jes = yes
		sp_i31_clear_caliph_war_token_if_peace = yes
	}
}
